column1: # Provisional game profile (generated by scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py from the survey with dm/games/profile_guess.py, not checked by hand)
# PEANUTS: a Peanuts Native profile (Banana Native has none for this title); whole file Peanuts' own
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: the game maps its memory itself into the alias region
# (8 GB of it in a 8.625 GB block; the first profile gave 4.375 GB in 5 GB, and both transitions below crashed). The nu resource pipeline asks the SDK's
# address-region allocator for a 160-192 MB window there (80-96 x 2 MB pages, main+0x8b51d0 out of the page allocator main+0x975840) at the start of a
# park run (160 MB) and at the return to the lab (192 MB) and does not check the failure: the guest memsets 0xa000000 / 0xc000000 bytes through a null
# pointer (sdk+0x5372d0, lr main+0x975a5c). All three Android runs show the region table pinned at +4.25/+4.26 GB of the 4.375 GB during boot with at
# most 2.26 GB mapped (it was falling at every crash), so no hole of 160 or 192 MB was left; the SDK answers from its own table with no svc, so the host
# logs nothing. The heap takes the rest and stays 128 MB.
